usageNotes: Use this to get a at-a-glance count of pending updates across all PDM-managed remote nodes without querying each node individually. The caller must hold Resource.Modify on /resource/{remote} for each remote they want included in the result; remotes the token lacks access to will be omitted. Returns synchronously — no UPID.

examples.summary: Fetch pending update counts for all managed remotes

tips: The 'remotes' object is keyed by remote name; missing remotes typically indicate a permission gap or an unreachable node.
Use this as a lightweight poll before deciding whether to invoke a per-remote package update operation.
API tokens are supported (allowtoken: true), making this safe to call from automation without interactive credentials.
